title: Set Matrix Zeroes
statement: Given an `m × n` matrix, if an element is `0`, set its **entire row and column** to `0`. Do it in place.

example.why: The zeros at (0, 0) and (0, 3) clear row 0 and columns 0 and 3.

idea: Writing zeros while scanning is a trap: a freshly written 0 is indistinguishable from an original one and would wipe out further rows and columns.
So separate the two jobs. **Pass 1**: only look, and record which rows and which columns contain an original 0.
**Pass 2**: set every cell to 0 whose row or column was recorded.

complexity.spaceWhy: The two sets. (The first row and column of the matrix itself can serve as the markers to reach O(1).)

steps.text: Our example: **`matrix = [[0,1,2,0],[3,4,5,2],[1,3,1,5]]`**. Each step runs one highlighted line of the code.
